newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee says earnings set record in quarter.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee says earnings set record in quarter.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp. Thursday reported record profits for the latest quarter and said it expected to repeat the strong results through the rest of its fiscal year.

The company, whose products include Sara Lee baked goods, Jimmy Dean pork sausages, Hanes legwear and Kiwi shoe polish, said it earned $206 million, or 41 cents a share, in its fiscal third quarter ended on March 29 compared with year-earlier profits of $188 million, or 37 cents a share.
Revenues rose to $4.64 billion from $4.44 billion.
Following the news, Sara Lee's stock rose $1.50 a share but later gave back some ground and was up 75 cents at $41.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.

"We are pleased to have posted increased sales and earnings as well as improved operating margins for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 and our expectations are to continue to report record results for the remainder of the 1997 fiscal year," Chairman John Bryan said.
The company said packaged meats sales rose 16.4 percent and bakery sales rose 11.2 percent but coffee and grocery revenues fell 1.3 percent due to the impact of a stronger dollar on European sales.
Household and body care sales were off 3.4 percent and personal products sales declined 1.1 percent.
